project_brief.title: Build a Rust CLI Tool for File Processing
project_brief.description: A command-line tool that processes files (e.g., search, replace, count lines, etc.) using Rust's standard library and popular crates like clap for argument parsing. The project will teach file I/O, error handling, and CLI design.
key_features: Output results to stdout or file

step_by_step_build_guide.title: Project Setup and Basic CLI with clap
step_by_step_build_guide.engineering_action: Initialize a new Rust project using Cargo. Add the `clap` crate as a dependency. Define a CLI structure with arguments for input file, output file, and operation type (e.g., count, search, replace). Implement argument parsing and print the parsed values to verify correctness.
step_by_step_build_guide.required_prereq_knowledge: Basic Rust syntax, Cargo project structure, modules, and understanding of command-line interfaces.

step_by_step_build_guide.title: File Reading and Counting Operations
step_by_step_build_guide.engineering_action: Implement file reading using `std::fs::File` and `std::io::BufReader`. Add functionality to count lines, words, and characters in a given file. Output the counts to stdout. Handle basic file-not-found errors with `?` operator and `match`.
step_by_step_build_guide.required_prereq_knowledge: File I/O in Rust (`std::fs`, `std::io`), iterators, string manipulation, and basic error handling with `Result`.

step_by_step_build_guide.title: Search and Replace Functionality
step_by_step_build_guide.engineering_action: Add search and replace operations. For search, read the file and find lines containing a given pattern (simple string or regex). For replace, replace all occurrences of the pattern with a replacement string. Optionally use `serde` to read a configuration file for patterns. Support multiple input files by accepting a list or glob pattern.
step_by_step_build_guide.required_prereq_knowledge: Pattern matching, regular expressions (optional), working with multiple files, and using external crates like `serde` for deserialization.

step_by_step_build_guide.title: Robust Error Handling and Output Options
step_by_step_build_guide.engineering_action: Refactor error handling to use custom error types (e.g., an enum implementing `std::error::Error`). Add support for outputting results to a file (via `--output` flag) or stdout. Implement graceful handling of edge cases (e.g., empty files, invalid patterns). Optionally add a `--verbose` flag for detailed logs.
step_by_step_build_guide.required_prereq_knowledge: Advanced error handling patterns, custom error types, file output, and CLI design best practices.

tradeoffs_noted: Time conflict: project needs ~60h (4w × 15h/w baseline), learner has 30h (5h/w × 6w). Deficit: 30h (50% short).
(a) Scope reduced to MVP feature set.
(c) Scaffold-assisted approach for boilerplate modules to save ~15-20 hours.

execution_model: Product-First Build Guide → Reverse Knowledge Mapping (45-Min Tasks)
